en.headline: AFCD takes eight-year-old dog identified as a pit bull mix
en.dek: Officers collected the dog on Friday after a complaint; the department said the owner produced no valid fighting-dog licence.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said officers met an owner on 28 August after a complaint of illegal keeping of a fighting dog and of a dog not being properly controlled in a public place. A veterinarian identified the eight-year-old black dog as a pit bull terrier mix, which is classed as a fighting dog under the Dangerous Dogs Regulation.

The department said the owner could not produce a valid fighting-dog licence, and the animal was taken to an animal management centre for observation and a temperament assessment. It said the keeper would be required to learn how to control and care for a dangerous dog before the animal was returned, and that a prosecution would follow if there was sufficient evidence.

The owner has described the dog as a sterilised American Staffordshire terrier adopted about four years ago and said it had no record of aggression. Fighting dogs, including pit bull terriers, Japanese Tosas, Argentine Dogos, Brazilian Filas and their crosses, must be muzzled and kept on a lead no longer than 1.5 metres in public and must be sterilised. Keeping such a dog without a licence can bring a fine of up to HK$50,000 and six months' imprisonment. The department began special dog-control patrols on Sunday.

zh.headline: 漁護署帶走八歲黑狗 獸醫鑑定屬比特鬥牛㹴混種
zh.dek: 署方周五接投訴後將狗隻帶回動物管理中心，指畜養人未能出示有效格鬥狗隻牌照。
body: 漁農自然護理署表示，早前接獲投訴指有人非法飼養格鬥狗隻，以及在公眾地方未有妥善管束狗隻，人員於8月28日與畜養人會面。署方獸醫師鑑定該隻八歲黑色狗隻為比特鬥牛㹴混種，屬《危險狗隻規例》下的格鬥狗隻。
署方指畜養人未能出示有效格鬥狗隻牌照，已將狗隻帶返動物管理中心觀察及作性情評估。漁護署稱，會要求畜養人學習如何管束和照顧危險狗隻後才交回狗隻；如有足夠證據，會依法提出檢控。
畜養人稱該狗為已絕育的美國史丹福㹴，約四年前領養，並指其性情溫馴、沒有襲擊紀錄。法例規定格鬥狗隻（包括比特鬥牛㹴、日本土佐犬、阿根廷杜告狗、巴西非拉狗及其混種）在公眾地方須戴指定頸圈及口套，並用不逾1.5米的狗帶牽引，且必須絕育。無牌飼養最高可罰款5萬元及監禁六個月。漁護署周日已展開特別巡查。
